_about: Special-event street closures (engine/events.py), from NYC's Permitted Event Information placed on NYC DOT's street centerline by fetch_closures.py. Each permit's event name is its organizer, so an event's closures group together and a recurring one splits where two days pass between dates. Events with at least 'bannerMin' closures get the map's banner 'lead' days ahead; 'organizers' can name or banner one by its permit's event name. The marathon's closures come from the City's closure notice (marathon.json, fetch_marathon.py), filed under the organizer 'TCS New York City Marathon'.
